notes.title: Patch 1.16
notes.content:
"[i]Another One.[/i]"

[list]
[*]Screenshots taken with the F12 key now work properly with Steam.
[*]Added more detailed info to Attributes' descriptions.
[*]Cursor is now less finicky when dealing with Confirmation boxes.
[*]Digging minigame now has a better interface.
[*]Slightly decreased the Disposition cost of Asking about Subjects to NPCs.
[*]Small fixes and improvements to characters' portraits.
[*]Fixed Bosses' Health bars still using placeholder graphics.
[*]Polished up the writing a bit.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.15
notes.content:
Bugfixes, small changes and some QoL improvements.

[list]
[*]Fixed a rare bug when casting spells from empty slots.
[*]Better text for the Blocking part of the Tutorial.
[*]Save Statues now play the Save sound when interacted with AUTOSAVE on.
[*]Disposition can now go over 100 during the chat minigame, being set to 100 after it's over.
[*]Victory window to-get exp and gold texts are now colored white.
[*]Slightly better stat description texts.
[*]Slightly faster Dummy attacks >:(
[*][b]You asked for it, and now here it is: Faster map movement speed![/b]
[/list]

Supplemental patch with some more fixes and changes.

[list]

[*]Fixed a bug during the tutorial also involving The Dummy.
[*]Slightly improved some bosses' death animation(like The Dummy).

[*]Spellcasting Tutorial now tells players to HOLD instead of PRESS the keys.

notes.title: 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Patch with changes and fixes based on players' first impressions:

[list]
[*][b]Much improved tutorial![/b]
[*]Halved Hunter's Spear Health drain.
[*]Better Fire Pillar spell cast effect.
[*]Faerie Summon spell description now tells the correct amount of healing.
[*]Gravity Reverse now makes all enemies flinch.
[*]Less time for next enemy icon trembling.
[*]Better effect for Fallen One's Shadow Image spell.

[*]Character portraits now stop talking when the text is done appearing.
[*]Map hazards can no longer kill on Casual difficulty.
[*]Slightly faster map HP/MP HUD fadeout.
[*]Lower pop text sound effect.
[*]Bigger Mana Crossbow bolt.
[*]Better polish on the Castle Sewers' Dungeon.
[*]Pyromancer and Cryomancer masters' sprites are now more prominent.

[*]Intro cut a bit shorter.
[*]Added button prompts to intro, character creation and battle victory scenes.
[*]Confirm window for inventory and save menus now appears on top of the cursor if it's being used.
[*]Negative stat points are now colored red in character creation.
[*]Stat icons put next to their body parts.
[*]Fixed the game menu transition being off at times.
[*]Fixed crash when pressing space in the pre-credits screen.
[/list]

[i]This is a big patch, and due to an engine update(to fix the Windows10 random crashes glitch), some save files may no longer work. We apologize profusely. However this'll be the last time such a thing will happen.[/i]

notes.title: Quick 1.01 patch
notes.content:
Patch to improve compatibility with Windows 10 plus some small changes and fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed some random crashes when playing on Windows 10.
[*]Fixed the sprite`s anchor point of one of Bloody Demon`s attack animations.

[*]Enemy call ally range on the map increased.
[*]Time before a new enemy arrives in battle decreased.
[/list]
